description: Read a free-text Indonesian address ("Jl. Margonda Raya No. 100 RT 3/5 Kemiri Muka, Beji, Depok 16423") into street, RT/RW, kode pos, and the Kemendagri kelurahan/desa, kecamatan, kabupaten/kota, and provinsi with their codes. Handles missing commas, capitals, abbreviations (Kel., Kec., Kab., Jaksel, Jabar), and left-out levels. Check confidence and issues: a kode pos that belongs to another kelurahan, a village that is not in the data, or an address that fits more than one region (see alternatives). Use it to clean address columns, fill region dropdowns from typed addresses, or check a shipping address. Also takes an [ADDRESS_n] placeholder from read_file_masked: the regions come back as they are, the street and RT/RW as placeholders.
name: parse_alamat
title: Parse an Indonesian address
